⚠️ Error Handling — Real Test Cases

Verified 2026-07-29

Three real failure scenarios run against this Snowflake account to verify how errors are surfaced and recovered from — not simulated.

1. Invalid table reference

Query against a table that doesn't exist. Snowflake returns a clear SQL compilation error instead of failing silently or returning bad data.

SQL compilation error: Object 'NONEXISTENT_TABLE' does not exist or not authorized.
2. Invalid column — graceful fallback

Query references a column that doesn't exist. System catches the error, lists the real available columns, and offers to retry — a real fallback flow, not a dead end.

invalid identifier 'WRONG_COLUMN_XYZ' → suggests C1..C5 as valid alternatives
3. Constraint violation + auto cleanup

A NOT NULL constraint blocks a bad insert on a disposable test table (real production data was never touched), and the test table is dropped automatically afterward.

NULL result in a non-nullable column — insert blocked on CATEGORY → table auto-dropped

Case 1: invalid table error

Case 2: invalid column + fallback suggestion

Case 3: constraint violation + cleanup

`; } function e2eAutomationPanel(){ const steps = [ {n:'1', icon:'📥', title:'Data Ingest', detail:'26,872 real support tickets loaded into INTELLIFLOW_DB.PUBLIC.CUSTOMER_SUPPORT_DATA in Snowflake.', proof:'See Data Sources page'}, {n:'2', icon:'🧠', title:'Reasoning', detail:'Cortex COMPLETE + CoCo CLI analyze ticket text, cluster into categories, and detect distress signals (e.g. "cannot afford" language).', proof:'See Cortex Functions panel above'}, {n:'3', icon:'⚖️', title:'Decision', detail:'Rules/agent logic branch on conditions — e.g. category volume, financial-distress keywords — to decide severity and next action.', proof:'See Architecture Diagram above'}, {n:'4', icon:'▶️', title:'Action', detail:'A Snowflake Task (CATEGORY_REPORT_TASK) is created and executed automatically — verified SUCCEEDED via TASK_HISTORY.', proof:'See Workflow Execution panel above'}, {n:'5', icon:'📤', title:'Report', detail:'Findings, recommendations and metrics are compiled into this report — the same one you\'re reading now.', proof:'This page'}, ]; const rows = steps.map((s,i)=>`
